items.title: Normalised almost-Besse contact forms: boundary behaviour and C1-closeness of the Reeb field
items.author: Alberto Abbondandolo; Christian Lange; Marco Mazzucchelli
items.work: Higher systolic inequalities for 3-dimensional contact manifolds
items.source_version: Journal de l'École polytechnique — Mathématiques 9 (2022), publisher version, DOI 10.5802/jep.195
items.difficulty_reason: Counted unit is the labelled lemma `l:nearly_Besse_normalized` at source lines 1289-1310, a four-part statement about the normalisation of an almost-Besse contact form: the pull-back of nu to the boundary agrees with nu_0, the two-form omega vanishes there, the normalised Reeb field extends smoothly and tangentially to the boundary, and it is C1-close to d/dt whenever the original Reeb field is C2-close to R_{lambda_0}. The author's proof (source lines 1312-1401) is a long computation in collar coordinates, not a citation: it first writes the gluing map tilde-iota on a collar A_C x S^1 and the normalised form tilde-lambda_0 explicitly in the coordinates (r,s,t) (lines 1313-1327), and the four conclusions are then read off from pull-back computations along that collar, including the smooth extension of the Reeb field and a quantitative C1-estimate that depends on the C2-closeness hypothesis. The enumeration in the statement hides that the four parts are established by different computations inside one collar chart.
